notes.clarification: The measure-preserving flow is supplied by Deng-Hani-Ma Proposition 1.2(3). The auxiliary truncated-flow statement is Proposition 4.5(4), via its pushforward definition (3.4). These are source locators for the existing fixed-time null-event argument.

Take r_rec to bound both the number of pulses and the number of labels carrying records, as in H04 lines 414-417. Both lists are fixed in the argument; Proposition 5.1 uses two pulses. This makes explicit the source parameter already referenced by the paper.

One may partition [0,T] into intervals of length at most u. Equivalently, for each t<=T partition [0,t], with at most ceil(T/u) intervals, and then take the supremum. Either reading yields the displayed deterministic bound.

The spatial offset delta_p denotes x_p^xi(b_p)-X on the constructed branch. Its independence of the final common translation X follows from the translation-equivariant construction. It is separate from the unindexed time increment delta=t-s and from Dirac-delta notation.

Credit H08, lemma lem:center-transfer and equation eq:limit-center-estimate, for the Holder exact-centering comparison. The uniform-in-time extension and Gaussian-continuity deduction are inherited from the project antecedent notes; neither is claimed as a new result.
